ITEM 1 | Whole red grapes in a loose cluster, roughly 20 berries, deep red to dark magenta with glossy skins, some slightly translucent; round, about 1.5-2 cm each, spread across the lower-left half of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Bright red, moist, juicy fruit pieces with smooth, slightly granular flesh, cut into irregular wedges and cubes about 2-3 cm, sitting on the upper-right of the plate | 95
ITEM 3 | Browned, charred-looking round pieces with dark brown, bumpy, slightly glossy surfaces and some caramelized patches, about 2.5-3 cm across, scattered among the grapes in the center | 90
ITEM 4 | Pale tan to light golden cubes with lightly browned edges and matte, firm surfaces, about 2.5-3 cm, one near the top center and one at the lower right beside the red fruit | 50
ITEM 5 | Pale off-white cube with a slightly yellowish, dry-looking surface and faint browning on one edge, about 3 cm, resting at the lower right edge of the plate | 30
